body.summary: Added the waiting path to LockManager.request. A request that cannot be granted first waits behind this thread's earlier requests for the name. It then registers a pending record, inside the name's mutex in the same critical section as the failed grant check: the slot is claimed by CAS to -(threadId + 1) and published last, and an exclusive request increments the pending-exclusive count. It then waits with Atomics.waitAsync on the version word, which it re-arms at least every 60 s, with a keep-alive timer for the length of each wait. On a timeout or abort it withdraws the record and the count and rejects with LockTimeoutError (naming the holders) or signal.reason. An already-aborted signal is refused before the name is even resolved, and a full pending table gives LockCapacityError('pending'). A helper worker proves the keep-alive.
